doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: 'My Favorite Things' and 'Blues to Elvin'
summary: Back in New York they recorded 'My Favorite Things'; the 'Blues to Elvin' tune led to talk of his guitar.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: So you did the one engagement in Denver then you came back to New York?
Yes. I could have met him in California, but I said, “Where is he going to be next?” So I went to Denver and met him there.
And then you came back to New York, and shortly there after made the “My Favorite Things Session”. And what was your next prolonged engagement in New York?

What did we play? I don’t know. I don’t know that we played in New York. Maybe it was Birdland; it might have been Birdland. I’m not so sure about that. Things get a little hazy to me I haven’t thought about this stuff in years.
How about the Trane, the Ballads LP? You say that “My Favorite Things” was the first thing you made with Coltrane rather than the Ballads?
Yes, the Ballads, we didn’t record that until the next year.
Maybe I’m confusing that with the blues, with “Coltrane Plays the Blues”?
That was, we played my tune on the first recording, “Blues to Elvin”. I used to play that on guitar.
